name: University of Southern California

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc has the most, 3,676. About 5.7 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Usc Arcadia Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc has the most, 3,676. About 4.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Keck Hospital of Usc have on its payroll in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital reports more; Usc Arcadia Hospital is next at 1,278. About 11.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Keck Hospital of Usc in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do University of Southern California's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians train in University of Southern California's hospitals, added together?
questions.why: One of its hospitals reports residents; Keck Hospital of Usc trains the most, 199.

questions.q: What percent of Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital runs higher; Usc Arcadia Hospital is next at 62 percent. Traditional Medicare was 49 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 18 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Usc Arcadia Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital runs highest, 67 percent. Traditional Medicare was 38 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 23 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Keck Hospital of Usc's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital runs highest, 67 percent. Traditional Medicare was 29 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 18 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc runs highest, 25 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 3 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 12 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Usc Arcadia Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc runs highest, 25 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 5 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 12 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Keck Hospital of Usc's inpatient days in fiscal 2024 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital runs higher; Usc Arcadia Hospital is next at 17 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 5 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 19 percent.

questions.q: Across all of University of Southern California's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of University of Southern California's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc has the most, 326 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Usc Arcadia Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc has the most, 326 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Keck Hospital of Usc report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital reports more; Usc Arcadia Hospital is next at 318 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc has the most, 82 ICU beds. That is 13 percent of its 134 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Usc Arcadia Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc has the most, 82 ICU beds. That is 21 percent of its 318 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Keck Hospital of Usc report to Medicare for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital reports more; Usc Arcadia Hospital is next at 66 ICU beds. That is 25 percent of its 326 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital report for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Usc Arcadia Hospital discharged the most, 14,674. About 14 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Usc Arcadia Hospital report for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital discharged more; Keck Hospital of Usc is next at 11,967. About 40 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Keck Hospital of Usc report for fiscal 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Usc Arcadia Hospital discharged the most, 14,674. About 33 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the shortest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc ran longest, 7.2 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Usc Arcadia Hospital in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc ran longest, 7.2 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Keck Hospital of Usc in fiscal 2024?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital kept patients longer; Usc Arcadia Hospital is next at 4.7 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2025, what percent of Usc Verdugo Hills Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That is the emptiest of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc ran fullest, 72 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2025, what percent of Usc Arcadia Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 University of Southern California hospitals; Keck Hospital of Usc ran fullest, 72 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2024, what percent of Keck Hospital of Usc's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: No other University of Southern California hospital ran fuller; Usc Arcadia Hospital is next at 60 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does University of Southern California run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in California. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many beds do University of Southern California's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many beds does University of Southern California's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Keck Hospital of Usc. Usc Arcadia Hospital is next, with 318.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do University of Southern California's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 21 percent of their 778 beds. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did University of Southern California's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 87 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.
